## File: facebookresearch_omni3d/cubercnn/util/math_util.py

Prompts

```
['compute the 3D vertices and face indices of a cuboid given its center, dimensions, and optional rotation matrix', 'project a 3D bounding box into 2D image coordinates using camera intrinsics and clip out-of-bounds vertices', 'compute the intersection over union between two sets of 2D bounding boxes in cross or list mode', 'convert a 3x3 rotation matrix into Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) using the standard decomposition', 'convert a camera rotation matrix to allocentric representation given a 2D pixel location and camera intrinsics', 'compute the estimated time remaining for a loop given a start time, current index, and total iterations', 'list all files matching a glob pattern in a directory and return them sorted alphabetically', 'read and deserialize a Python object from a pickle file with optional encoding support', 'get a jittered RGB color from the COCO category palette by index or randomly', 'compute the similarity ratio between two strings using difflib SequenceMatcher']
```

Usage

```
{'compute_cuboid_vertices_and_faces': 'compute the 3D vertices and face indices of a cuboid given its center, dimensions, and optional rotation matrix', 'project_3d_box_to_2d': 'project a 3D bounding box into 2D image coordinates using camera intrinsics and clip out-of-bounds vertices', 'compute_iou_between_boxes': 'compute the intersection over union between two sets of 2D bounding boxes in cross or list mode', 'convert_rotation_matrix_to_euler': 'convert a 3x3 rotation matrix into Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) using the standard decomposition', 'convert_rotation_to_allocentric': 'convert a camera rotation matrix to allocentric representation given a 2D pixel location and camera intrinsics'}
```
